long_biography.plain_text:
Fawziya Saud Salim Bahwan Al Mukhaini has a long-running role in family capital. She exercises significant control over Waldsburg Holdings, appears as a partner in Omani investment and property businesses, and has served as a director of Sun Mountain Capital. She also established a separate trust holding structure alongside two sisters.

Outside finance, she has sustained an interest in Arabian horses. She owns several show horses and has bred a current colt, connecting a private sporting interest with an activity maintained across multiple seasons. Her public profile otherwise remains deliberately limited, with no verified personal website or social account.
